ordinary_settings_scope: Six matched whole-workflow checks: 30 seconds for gates24/tokke6 and 120 seconds for tokke24. HiGHS uses its library thread default; SCIP uses one thread. Input-specific warmup schedules are discarded. The final SCIP daily check is an isolated rerun after briefly overlapping test startup; timings from the discarded run are not used.
cold_scope: Fresh Julia process with the production environment, first solve on the single-reservoir example. Loading, full example elapsed time and solve-reported elapsed time are separate; no warm-up call.

selection.workflow: SCIP proposals and global search, Ipopt nonlinear dispatch
selection.criterion: Comparable accepted schedule quality and reliability, useful runtime, and one fewer production solver dependency. A subpercent isolated objective tradeoff is accepted; no input-dependent solver selection.
